title.narrative: Sustainable Urban Transport Investment Program - Tranche 3

description.narrative: Project 3 will improve the urban transport system and infrastructure in urban areas and comprises two subprojects: (i) section 2 (km 4.0-10.8) of the international standard Tbilisi-Rustavi Urban Road Link; and (ii) phase 2 of Anaklia Coastal Improvement; both of which are in line with components of the Investment Program. These investments will improve the urban environment, strengthen economic and tourism development, and regional integration.

Output: Urban transport infrastructure extended, rehabilitated, and improved by MDF and relevant municipalities. Indicator: A 6.8 km long Tbilisi-Rustavi urban road link completed (section 2), including creation of recreational areas and improved pedestrian facilities Achievement: Y Progress/Status: Since the project was subjected to compliance review, the no-objection for contract award was also subjected to partial hand over of contract sites. The sections where the safeguard issues are under compliance review (about 3 km section in Ponichala) were handed over to the contractor last, after resolution of the issues or outcome of the compliance review. The Board approved the remedial action plan in June 2017.
Further to the completion of additional studies, proposed solutions were included in the RAP-Final Solution (RAP-FS), which was reviewed by the Board Committee on Compliance Review on 6 March 2018, and disclosed on 3 April 2018. Progress in the implementation of the RAP has been slow due to continued opposition to the project from the community, i.e. residents have not allowed access to the buildings. Thus, strengthening of buildings cannot be done & road works not initiated in the area. The site-specific environmental management plan (SSEMP) has been developed and further revised following comments from the CRP. Noise & vibration monitoring plans have been prepared. However, designs for strengthening of buildings have not been completed due to the impossibility to access the buildings and the site. Since road works cannot be initiated in the area, the project cannot be completed by the loan closing date. MRDI and MDF have considered alternatives including resettlement in order to be able to complete the project. However, the initial assessment concluded these would not be viable in the short term.
Following the Review Mission that was fielded in February 2019, the government proposed removal of remaining works under phases 1 and 2 from the Project as the connection between the subsections improved under phase 1 will be carried out through the existing road in Ponichala instead of the alignment as envisaged under Section 2.
Temporary Spoil Site has been dismantled and partial retaining wall infrastructure within the Mtkvari River has been removed. All relevant remedial actions from the RAP-FS have been addressed. Works were financed by government's funds.
Full tree plantation has been completed within 2021. Works were financed by government's funds.
Partial Loan Cancellation: Per letter dated 31 July 2019, the Government requested for partial loan cancellation of $27 million which was endorsed by ADB following the memo dated 2 September 2019. The revised loan amount of $46 million is already reflected in the loan information system accordingly.
Project is Physically closed since 18 July 2020
